$comment: Taxonomy of the ways money moves in digital economies. Structure only: no market numbers live here. Numbers live in economies.json, supply-chain.json and macro.json, each with a source URL and retrieval date. Margin formulas use the variable names defined in `variables`.

variables.P: price the buyer pays us, per unit
variables.C: our direct cost per unit (inference, media, hosting, fulfilment)
variables.T: platform or marketplace take rate, as a fraction
variables.F: payment / merchant-of-record fee, as a fraction
variables.R: commission or revenue-share rate paid to us, as a fraction
variables.V: buyer spend at the partner, per period

models.name: Recurring affiliate commission
models.flow: Reader clicks a disclosed link, subscribes at the partner, partner pays us a share of each renewal for the program's window.
models.unitMarginFormula: R * V per period, for the program's recurring window; our C is content and hosting only

models.name: Own digital product via merchant of record
models.flow: Buyer pays on our checkout (Polar, Lemon Squeezy, Paddle, Gumroad); MoR handles tax and remits.

models.name: Listing on someone else's marketplace
models.flow: We list a product where buyers already are (App Store, Steam, Envato, Framer, Apify Store, Shopify App Store); platform keeps T.

models.name: Running a marketplace
models.flow: Third-party sellers list on our surface; we keep a take rate on GMV.
models.unitMarginFormula: GMV * T_ours - payment costs - moderation and payout ops

models.name: Software subscription
models.flow: Recurring fee for a hosted product.
models.unitMarginFormula: (P - C_hosting - C_inference) * (1-F) per seat-month; LTV = margin / churn

models.name: Metered API resale with markup
models.flow: We buy tokens or media generations wholesale and sell metered access inside our product or API.
models.unitMarginFormula: P_per_unit - C_per_unit, where C_per_unit is the vendor list price (minus caching or batch discounts)
risks: vendor price cuts erase the markup story
routers (OpenRouter, AI Gateway) make price transparent

models.name: Bring-your-own-key tooling
models.flow: Customer's agent and API key are the runtime; we sell the skill, workflow or template, not the tokens (estate doctrine, TRUTH.md section 2).
models.unitMarginFormula: P - P*F - f; C_inference is zero for us

models.name: Scoped implementation by agent teams
models.flow: Fixed-scope build delivered by agents under human gates; buyer owns the repo.
models.unitMarginFormula: P - agent compute - human review hours * rate
risks: hour-coupled if review does not shrink

models.name: Pay-per-call agent endpoints
models.flow: An agent pays per request (x402 over HTTP, Stripe agentic payments) for a tool or dataset we expose over MCP or HTTP.
humanGates: money operations (Doctrine 0: agents stage, humans execute)

models.name: Ads and sponsorship
models.flow: Audience attention sold to advertisers or sponsors (newsletter slots, YouTube partner revenue).

models.name: Royalties and licensing
models.flow: Music streams, sync licences, book royalties, IP licences paid per use.

models.name: Games and UGC-platform payouts
models.flow: Premium sales, in-app purchases, or payouts from a UGC platform (Roblox DevEx, Fortnite creator economy).
models.unitMarginFormula: P*(1-T) - C for premium; payout-rate * engagement for UGC platforms

models.name: Datasets and intelligence feeds
models.flow: Curated, sourced data sold as a subscription or per query (Private Intel, registries, MCP queries).

models.name: On-chain protocol fees and royalties
models.flow: Fees accrue to a protocol, contract or creator royalty on-chain.
models.unitMarginFormula: fee rate * volume - gas and ops
humanGates: any token or financial product (out of scope without counsel)

models.name: Domain portfolio
models.flow: Domains developed into sites, leased, or sold.
models.unitMarginFormula: sale or lease price - acquisition and renewal
